title: One name in three or more roles
question: Does the same rare name appear as officer of a funded organization, registered lobbyist or consultant, paid campaign staff, commissioner and City employee, three or more at once?
finding: 62 rare names appear in three or more of the five roles. Only 1 has a second, independent link for every pairing of three roles and is listed; 6 have such a link for at least two pairings. On this test almost nothing unusual was found.
how: Five records were joined by full name: officers, directors and key employees on the tax returns of City-funded organizations (tax years ending 2019 or later); registered lobbyists and permit consultants (Ethics Commission); people paid a salary or consulting fee of $1,000 or more by a campaign committee, and treasurers where the transaction file names one; Form 700 filers whose position is commissioner or board member; and City employees (payroll jobs that are themselves board or commission seats do not count twice). Only names that pass the rarity test of the people screen were kept. A person is listed only when three roles are each tied to the other two by something other than the name: the department of the City job or City body pays the organization; the organization is the registrant's client; the organization or its staff gave to the committee; the lobbyist reports contacts with the same department or a gift to the same committee; the City body and the payroll job are in one department.
limits: Being linked is not being involved: nonprofits share board members, buildings and auditors all the time, and San Francisco is a small city. A group is a place to look, ranked by how many independent signs sit inside it. A name is not a person: every row is a name match unless the second link is the same department. The question for someone serving on a board, sitting on a commission and working for the City at once is whether the rules on incompatible activities and recusal were followed; commissioners are often chosen because they lead community organizations. The campaign file names few treasurers, so that role is mostly paid staff. Private individuals are not listed for holding one or two of these roles.

rows.which: officer or director of a funded organization; member of a City board or commission; City employee
rows.match: Same name in each record; not confirmed to be the same person
